lure: A new device connected to your bank account
ask: Call the number on the back of your card if it was not you

message.subject: Security alert: new device connected
message.body: A new device connected to your Chase account. If this was not you, call the number on the back of your card.

source.attribution: Prudence demo cases (Scam Shield), CC BY 4.0

verdict.headline: Be careful: a real alert, so call your bank yourself.
reasons: The message is genuine and asks for nothing on a link.
Use the number on your card, never a number in a message.
